name: india-trader-skill
description: The India Trader skill pack for Claude: NSE and BSE, paper first

plugins.name: india-trader-skill
plugins.description: Twelve Claude skills for the Indian stock market: a chart scanner for the Nifty 500 and F&O, a news and NSE-filings monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a budget manager in rupees with STT and charges, a risk gate on NSE circuit and ASM/GSM data, an order executor (paper by default; Angel One, Upstox, Groww; never without your yes), price and exit alerts, a results analyst, an insider and bulk-deal tracker, and a nightly shortlist of five swing and five intraday names with the exit list.
